groups.title: Europe
items: Spain - 295,720 ha burned through September 2 (EFFIS/Copernicus), 45.6% of all EU burned area; third worst season in 30 years. Italy has 543 fires, Spain 433 and France 357.
Croatia - Omis: 900-1,000 ha burned, 1 dead, 36-40 injured and over 2,000 evacuated.
Germany and Greece - Serious fires in Hurtgenwald and Boeotia; 1,800 and over 1,000 evacuations respectively.
France - 98,000-116,000 ha burned, a 20-year satellite-record range. Portugal: Viseu burned about 13,000 ha.
Italy - 40,000 to over 100,000 ha depending on source; Sicily and Calabria are worst hit.
European Union - 647,375 ha burned through September 2; 2026 is the fourth worst year on record.

groups.title: Africa
items: Algeria - 154 fires in 24 hours at peak; 6 deaths and about 150 homes affected in Annaba.

groups.title: Asia
items: Turkey - About 95,000 ha burned, seven times the historical average.
Russia (Siberia) - About 600,000 ha burned in 2026.

groups.title: North America
items: Canada - 3,848 fires and 2.92 million ha burned; Thunder Bay 36 has burned 314,000 ha and remains uncontained.
United States - Fire alert raised to maximum level.

groups.title: South America
items: Ecuador - At least 300 ha burned in Cotacachi-Cayapas; over 4,000 ha burned nationally in early August.
Brazil - 1.76 million ha and 4,682 fire events in 2026.

groups.title: Oceania
items: Australia - Over 400,000 ha burned in Victoria in January; the southern-summer season has passed.

groups.title: Global context
items: 112.3 million ha burned worldwide by August 1 (GWIS); Africa accounted for 55%.
Oceans - Record average sea-surface temperature: 20.86 C on June 21; 37% under a marine heatwave.

items.text: According to Greenpeace, 95% of wildfires have a human origin - intentional, negligent or accidental - rather than being purely natural.

en.sources: Sources: MITECO, EFFIS/Copernicus, Global Wildfire Information System, national civil-protection agencies, CIFFC, Ecuador SNGR, Brazil Ministry of Environment, AFAC/NEMA, Greenpeace Spain, NOAA and Copernicus Marine Service.

groups.title: 欧洲
items: 西班牙截至9月2日过火295,720公顷，占欧盟45.6%；为30年来第三差季节。欧盟共647,375公顷，为第四差年份。

groups.title: 非洲
items: 阿尔及利亚高峰期24小时154起火灾；安纳巴6人死亡。

groups.title: 亚洲
items: 土耳其过火95,000公顷；俄罗斯西伯利亚2026年约600,000公顷。

groups.title: 北美洲
items: 加拿大3,848起火灾、过火292万公顷；美国警报升至最高级别。

groups.title: 南美洲
items: 厄瓜多尔Cotacachi-Cayapas至少过火300公顷。巴西2026年过火176万公顷、4,682起事件。

groups.title: 大洋洲
items: 澳大利亚维多利亚州1月过火逾400,000公顷。

groups.title: 全球背景
items: 截至8月1日全球过火1.123亿公顷（GWIS），非洲占55%。海洋温度创20.86 C纪录，37%处于海洋热浪中。
